ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in quadrilateral $ABCD$, $\angle ABC = \angle ADC = 90^\circ$, $E$ is the midpoint of diagonal $AC$, connecting $BE$, $ED$, $BD$. If $\angle BAD = 58^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle EBD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle ABC = \angle ADC = 90^\circ$,\\
points A, B, C, D lie on the same circle with E as the center and AC as the diameter.\\
Since $\angle BAD = 58^\circ$,\\
$\angle DEB = 116^\circ$.\\
Since DE = BE = $\frac{1}{2}$AC,\\
$\angle EBD = \angle EDB = \boxed{32^\circ}$.
